name: Veilpetal Glade
introDiscord:
Silvery petals drift through a glade so densely that entire paths vanish
behind them. Veilpetal Rays glide beneath the flowers, lifting the
petal curtains only when they choose to be seen.
introTwitch:
Silvery petals drift through a glade so densely that entire paths vanish
behind them. Veilpetal Rays glide beneath the flowers, lifting the
petal curtains only when they choose to be seen.

veilpetal-glade-approach.prompt:
Three paths wind through curtains of pale petals. Something wide keeps
moving beneath the flowerbed without disturbing a single bloom.

left.message:
A mound of petals rises.

Two glowing eyes appear underneath.

A Veilpetal Ray bursts from its floral blanket, apparently furious that
you noticed the world's least convincing flower.

right.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's abandoned flower crown.

Her note reads:

'Made crown.

Glimmer refused crown.

Ray stole crown.

Found crown again.

Crown has lived full life.'

forward.message:
An offering basket lies behind a curtain of silver petals. The flowers
part when you approach, revealing Star Candies arranged like the center
of a blossom.

veilpetal-glade-depths.prompt:
Living rootways wind beneath drifting Fae lights while petals swirl
through three narrow garden corridors.

left.message:
A moonblossom pool rests beneath folded petals. Shizuki left a note:

'Excellent healing spot.

Petal Ray used me as pillow.

Would return.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched. You're already healthy, and there is no
need to disturb any potential Ray bedding.

right.message:
A Veilpetal Ray sweeps through the garden trailing petals behind it.

One lands on your head.

The Ray circles back.

Apparently that petal was not complimentary.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a cache of Star Candies beneath a giant blossom.
Several petals fold over the bundle like gift paper.

veilpetal-glade-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds curl toward Curtained Moon Grove, where three routes
disappear behind enormous hanging blossoms.

left.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer rests beneath an arch of petals. Opening
it releases Star Candies and approximately enough flower petals for one
extremely dramatic entrance.

right.message:
Restorative sap waits beneath Shizuki's handwritten label:

'Flower medicine.

Flower unrelated to medicine.

Flower insisted on being included.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the sap and its apparently very important decorative flower.

forward.message:
A curtain of petals rises by itself.

A Veilpetal Ray was holding it.

The performance becomes hostile.

boss-antechamber.name: Curtained Moon Grove
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every petal in the glade lifts from the ground and begins circling the
same enormous silhouette.

bossPromptDiscord:
The flower curtains across Curtained Moon Grove pull aside.

Something vast glides beneath them, its wings large enough to lift the
entire garden in its wake.

Every smaller Veilpetal Ray disappears beneath the blossoms.

Use /yes to enter the Grove or /no to let the curtain fall again.
bossPromptTwitch:
The flower curtains across Curtained Moon Grove pull aside.

Something vast glides beneath them, its wings large enough to lift the
entire garden in its wake.

Every smaller Veilpetal Ray disappears beneath the blossoms.

Use !yes to enter the Grove or !no to let the curtain fall again.
bossRetreatText:
You step back. The petals descend, hiding the enormous silhouette once
more.

boss.revealText:
A storm of silver petals erupts as vast wings unfold.

Veilpetal Grandwing reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Grandwing settles beneath the flowers.

The petals drift gently back into place.

One lands on your head.

This time, nobody attacks."
